To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The fundamental category is a category whose objects are points in a space and whose morphisms are equivalence classes of directed paths between the objects.
the fundamental category is the fundamental category of the topological space with respect to the distinguished set of paths.

the fundamental group of a space is a special case of the fundamental category of the space; the fundamental bipartitie graph is a special case; the fundamental category of a space can be recovered from a model of it; and the van Kampen theorem holds for the fundamental category of any space.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of topological spaces with an additional structure which is a set of directed paths, and with the study of fundamental categories of such spaces.
the homotopy theory of topological spaces with distinguished sets of paths.
the homotopical properties of directed paths and how these properties relate to the classical theory of homotopy groups and fundamental groupoids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
directed homotopy is a generalization of homotopy in which directed paths replace loops.
the fundamental category and its van Kampen theorem are a natural generalization of the fundamental group and its van Kampens theorems to directed homotopy.
directed homotopy is the homotopy theory for directed paths.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we develop a theory of fundamental categories for directed spaces.
the fundamental category is the right notion for directed homotopies, and the van Kampen theorem is the right result for the fundamental category.
directed homotopy can be used to study the topology of spaces with distinguished paths, such as graphs, directed complexes, and surfaces.
The main takeaway from our work is that
directed homotopy categories are more general than homotopy groupoids.
the fundamental category is a useful invariant for studying directed homotopy types, and that the fundamental bipartites graph and extremal models are useful invariants for computing it.
directed homotopy is a rich theory that is well-suited for applications.
